chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad Al-Kindi, from someone else, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
Walk in front of the funeral procession and behind it.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended way to walk during a Shia funeral procession?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this concise hadith from Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) establishes the permissibility and recommendation of walking both ahead of and behind the coffin, reflecting the comprehensive communal participation in funeral rites. Scholars note that this practice underscores the dignity of the deceased and the collective responsibility of the community, distinguishing Shia jurisprudence in its detailed guidance on procession etiquette.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Al Kindy, from someone else, from Aban Bin Usman, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Walk in front of the coffin and behind it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad al-Kindiy from more than one person from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
(In a funeral procession) walk in front or behind (the coffin).”’
